name: Quill
tagline: Ultra-minimalist macOS meeting recorder — record mic and system audio as two separate tracks, transcribe fully on-device
description: Quill is a one-click meeting recorder for macOS that captures the microphone and system audio as two separate tracks, then transcribes everything on-device using Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 running through Core ML. The transcript is speaker-tagged, and because transcription never leaves the machine, recordings are private by default. It lives in the menu-bar tray, ships as a single Swift binary, and writes crash-safe CAF audio so an interrupted recording is never lost. Swift and MIT-licensed, at 2.1k stars, with roughly 20 seconds of transcription needed per hour of audio.
highlights: One-click record captures mic and system audio as two separate tracks
Fully on-device transcription via Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 on Core ML — nothing leaves the machine
Speaker-tagged transcripts with a menu-bar tray workflow
Single Swift binary with crash-safe CAF audio recording
~20s on-device transcription per hour of audio
curatorNote: A tiny, single-binary recorder that does split-track capture and local transcription quietly in the menu bar. The local-first, nothing-leaves-the-machine stance makes it refreshingly trustworthy for sensitive meetings.
